text: Hi there! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Tuesday, November 10. Tuesday already. Well done for a good start! Today in Shanghai, it will be rather grey and cloudy. It will reach 14 degrees, and drop down to 7 degrees. A bit parky today, as they say. Rain is very unlikely today. Did you know today is day 314 of the year? There are 51 days to go until the new one. Look up at the clouds today. Can you find one shaped like an animal? As for tomorrow, expect it to be covered in clouds, with a high of 18 degrees. Remember, our theme this week is warm drinks. What have you noticed today? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
